notes.title: Week-2 is coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38274604/9ce4d060b52f2af65ed48aa208da4f208429c30f.png[/img]
Hey! everyone! Our team has worked for more than a year on the game and we are closing on the final version of week-2. Right now we are working on the last day of the week and the extended edition of the game. Adding the sound, effects, and final scenes.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1684170/Fetish_Locator_Week_Two/][u][b]WEEK-2 STEAM PAGE[/b][/u][/url]
[b]It would be an awesome help if you would add the game to your wishlist! This helps with Steam algorithms and game promotion![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38274604/6244c21b0e9f8cab13fb94be42ae4de2f41ce314.png[/img]
[h1]About week-2[/h1]
Week-2 is all about the crazy challenges that our protagonist will have to face. He's finally dating the girl of his dreams but is now trapped in the Fetish Locator Retention Program. He is now facing even harder challenges and has to unleash his inner lewd self to be able to conquer that fetish craziness!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38274604/7f4382a4f8f3ee0e6a4d06c5ee2bc3d88ab32d96.png[/img]
[h1]Save Files[/h1]
You will be able to continue the game with the choices that you made during week-1. The game will offer you this option automatically if you made the save during the week-1 at the right time when the game prompted you to do so.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38274604/0343c56e7f0dcddb328caa036db886afa71d218f.png[/img]
[h1]Translations[/h1]
I can't promise you that the game will have all the same translations on release, but we will work on adding them after the release. Unfortunately, since the game isn't available in Germany we can't invest into German translation and it will only be available if the community will translate it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38274604/41922018d45cbc312491c3705a300774178cc6c1.jpg[/img]
[h1]Future[/h1]
At this point, our team is already spending a lot of time building the plan for the Week-3 story and how the last part of Fetish Locator should go. We are still aiming at making 18 different endings for the game that should all come to you in Week-3. That is quite a challenging mark. But I want to make Fetish Locator into an awesome experience where you can see many awesome endings to the story!
Fetish Locator isn't the only thing that is coming. Join our discord, follow on Twitter to be the first to know what is coming next ;)

notes.title: Hear me roar!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! 
Holiday season is about to start, and today I want to tell you about our update v1.0.28 where we added new voice effects to the game. We worked with voice actors to get unique impressions and give the game's story more life!

[b]Change Log v1.0.28:[/b]
[list]
[*] Almost every scene in the game got small voice impressions and highlights in the key moments.
[*] Almost every scene in the game got additional sound effects to make the surrounding feel better.
[*] Scene 04 on Day-1 has been updated with new animations.
[/list]

[b]Adding a remark here[/b] - The game isn't fully voiced. We wanted to add voice expressions where our characters just make expressive sounds in the important story moments. Unfortunately fully voicing the game isn't really possible now, for a game of our size. But I hope you would like the update that will give much better impression on our characters!

[b]Sad news[/b] - While preparing this update I found out that the game is banned now in Germany. That is not only affecting me, but also all the games on the market. Unfortunately there is no solution to this and we just lost a huge portion of our market.

[b]Known issues[/b]
One of the known issues in this update is that although we now have Voices in the game, you can't control the volume with the voice slider. For now the volume of voice effects are controlled with the "Sound Volume" slider. We already know about the issue and will fix it in the next update.
